jurisdiction: Yamoussoukro District/city municipality; national IDUFCI and SIGFU platforms cover urban land parcels, with municipal technical services responsible for the local cadastre.
registryBasis: Official IDUFCI explains the unique land-parcel identifier and national parcel-map mission; SIGFU public landing page advertises parcel/lot search and cartography; the city council technical service says it proposes updates to Yamoussoukro's cadastre.
findings: Official IDUFCI explains the unique land-parcel identifier and national parcel-map mission; SIGFU public landing material advertises parcel/lot search and cartography; the city council technical service describes Yamoussoukro cadastre updates. Direct anonymous GET confirms the SIGFU site and /parcelles route return an HTTP 200 Angular shell, not data. The publicly linked production JavaScript configures the parcel-data API and identifies public locality, commune, and lot lookup routes. Bounded GETs to the configured API base and three read-only lookup routes returned HTTP 502 (166-byte nginx error pages). No API response or polygon was confirmed. A single secondary-network check failed TLS certificate validation before HTTP. Preserve the source lead; do not interpret the 502 or network errors as geometry absence.

The production bundle sets apiDataBasePath=https://sigfu.gouv.ci/api-sigfu-portail-data and exposes GET /query-parcelle/query-parcelle/localites, GET /query-parcelle/query-parcelle/AllLots, GET /query-parcelle/query-commune, and POST /query-parcelle/query-parcelle/allLotissements under that base. Anonymous GETs to the base and first three routes each returned HTTP 502; no guessed POST body was sent.
